description: This file is a Python script for generating C++ source files related to static runtime operations in PyTorch. It includes functions for grouping native functions, formatting, and writing C++ code, and a main function that orchestrates the code generation process based on YAML configuration files.

methods.name: group_functions_by_op_name
methods.description: Groups a sequence of native functions by their base operation name, filtering supported functions.

methods.name: clang_format
methods.description: Formats a C++ file using clang-format.

methods.name: write_cpp
methods.description: Writes a sequence of C++ code strings to a file, wrapping with necessary includes and namespace declarations.

methods.name: write_test_cpp
methods.description: Writes a sequence of C++ test code strings to a file, including test setup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, loads YAML configs, generates grouped native functions, and writes C++ source files.
